articles.title: Live coverage: SpaceX to launch 25 Starlink satellites to polar, low Earth orbit
articles.summary: The Starlink 17-20 mission will be the seventh Starlink mission this year. Liftoff from pad 4E is scheduled for 7:38:20 a.m. PST (10:38:20 a.m. EST / 1538:20 UTC).

articles.title: NASA and DOE to collaborate on lunar nuclear reactor development
articles.summary:
NASA and the Department of Energy have agreed to work together on development of nuclear reactors for the moon as industry awaits the release of a final call for proposals.

articles.title: RFA Awarded ESA Flight Ticket Initiative Launch Contracts
articles.summary:
German rocket builder Rocket Factory Augsburg (RFA) has been awarded launch service contracts for two missions under the Flight Ticket Initiative. The Flight Ticket Initiative is a programme run jointly by the European Space Agency (ESA) and the European Union that provides subsidised launch opportunities for European companies and organisations on small launch vehicles.
